component.name: WhereAmI
component.summary: Explore and manage GPX location history

description.p: WhereAmI is a desktop waypoint and GPX viewer for exploring and managing location data on an interactive vector map.

ul.li: Import GPX files and search recorded waypoints
Add, rename, tag, and remove bookmarked locations
Filter location history by tag or date
Explore significant locations with timelines and place summaries
Cache previously viewed map areas for offline use

screenshot.caption: Viewing imported waypoints on the world map

description.p: WhereAmI 0.2.0 adds worldwide vector maps and new ways to explore location history.

ul.li: Navigate significant locations with travel timelines and map-first journeys
Review private on-device country, region, locality, and date summaries
Filter observations by day, date range, or preset
Use more reliable GPX imports and safer bookmark storage
